skill.name: seo-geo
skill.description: Audit websites for technical SEO and generative engine visibility, research keywords through DataForSEO, and create metadata, structured data, and prioritized recommendations.
skill.summary: Audit and improve website visibility across traditional search engines and AI answer platforms.
skill.author: resciencelab

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms expected outbound requests to selected websites and the fixed DataForSEO API; most alerts are documentation or lexical false positives. The local audit accepts arbitrary URLs without blocking private, loopback, or link-local destinations, creating a high-confidence SSRF risk. No prompt injection or malicious credential handling was found.

remediation.issue: Arbitrary URL fetching can reach internal services.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only public HTTP and HTTPS addresses. Revalidate DNS and redirects, block private ranges, and limit response size before parsing.

content.user_title: Improve SEO and AI Search Visibility
content.value_statement: Technical issues, weak metadata, and unclear content reduce website visibility. This skill audits those gaps and produces practical SEO and GEO recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Audits titles, descriptions, H1 headings, Open Graph tags, JSON-LD, load time, robots.txt, and sitemap availability for a supplied website.
Researches keywords, related searches, autocomplete suggestions, SERP results, backlinks, domain metrics, and competitor gaps through DataForSEO.
Creates page-specific metadata and structured data recommendations using included Schema.org templates.
Evaluates content structure for answer-first writing, citations, statistics, headings, internal links, and AI crawler access.
Compares optimization priorities across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude.
Produces a prioritized SEO and GEO report with current status, recommendations, and validation steps.
limitations: Live keyword, SERP, backlink, and competitor data requires valid DataForSEO credentials and may consume paid API credits.
The local audit fetches the supplied URL but does not run a browser, execute JavaScript, or measure rendered page behavior.
Search rankings and AI citations cannot be guaranteed because platform algorithms and indexes change.
Recommendations require human review before publishing metadata, schema, citations, or content claims.

use_cases.title: Audit a Small Business Website
use_cases.description: Find technical, metadata, crawlability, and structured-data gaps, then receive a prioritized list of practical fixes.

use_cases.title: Optimize a Content Brief
use_cases.description: Turn keyword intent, competitor evidence, citations, and answer-first structure into a focused article brief.

use_cases.title: Plan Competitive Growth
use_cases.description: Compare domains, keyword gaps, SERP positions, and backlinks to build a measured search growth plan.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Website Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [URL] for titles, descriptions, headings, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap access, and load time. Rank the five most important fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a quick technical review of one public website.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [page URL] for [primary keyword]. Recommend improved metadata, headings, internal links, answer-first content, citations, and suitable structured data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve one existing page for search and AI answer visibility.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Content Opportunity
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] for [audience] in [location]. Compare intent, demand, difficulty, related queries, and likely competitors using available data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an evidence-based brief before drafting new content.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitive SEO and GEO Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [site] with [competitors]. Identify keyword gaps, backlink differences, technical issues, schema opportunities, and platform-specific GEO actions. Produce a phased ninety-day plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate advanced research across technical, content, authority, and AI visibility work.

output_examples.input: Audit https://example.com and prioritize technical fixes.
output: Priority 1: Add a concise meta description to the home page.
Priority 2: Publish a valid sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.
Priority 3: Add verified organization details through structured data.

output_examples.input: Research keywords for an accounting platform serving small businesses.
output_examples.output: The report groups commercial and informational themes, compares demand and difficulty, and recommends a primary topic with supporting article opportunities.

output_examples.input: Improve an article for AI answer engines.
output: Place a direct, sourced answer below the main heading.
Add verified statistics and clear attribution near relevant claims.
Organize follow-up questions into concise sections with suitable structured data.

best_practices: Confirm that every analyzed domain is public and authorized before running network checks.
Verify keyword metrics, citations, statistics, and structured data claims before publishing recommendations.
Prioritize crawlability and accurate page metadata before expanding content or pursuing platform-specific GEO tactics.
anti_patterns: Do not audit private, local, or internal network addresses.
Do not publish placeholder URLs, unsupported statistics, or unverified expert quotations.
Do not treat keyword stuffing, excessive schema, or repeated AI-focused phrasing as a visibility strategy.

faq.question: Does the skill change my website?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes supplied information and produces recommendations. You decide which changes to implement.

faq.question: Do I need DataForSEO credentials?
faq.answer: No for the basic website audit. Keyword, SERP, backlink, domain, and competitor research requires valid credentials.

faq.question: Can it guarantee rankings or AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It improves observable signals, but search engines and AI platforms control indexing, ranking, and citation decisions.

faq.question: Which search platforms are covered?
faq.answer: Guidance covers Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude, with platform-specific recommendations where available.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a public URL, business goals, target audience, location, priority topics, and relevant competitors.

faq.question: What data leaves my environment?
faq.answer: Website checks contact selected domains. Optional research sends keywords and domains to DataForSEO using your account.
